about: System app slots (parking spots) and the app that fills each by default. Any app that `provides:` a slot can replace the default. null = the spot exists, no default app is published yet. `repo` = where a default comes from before it's in the public index (private; needs a GitHub login that can see it). `provides` = known capabilities copied from that app's wizard.md for offline manifest checking, not extra install slots.

multi_capabilities.about: Capabilities (not system spots) that a consumer reads from every installed provider at once, like a multi spot: a front end that `uses:` one is linked to each provider's network, not only the owner's active one, and several providers are not a collision. Health reads every wearable connector this way.

chats.name: Chats
chats.note: Built-in wizard-chats plus owner-installed in-document Chats views; shared Agent Service conversations.

shell.name: Shell (Wizard UX)
shell.note: Unmerged modular-shell candidate; independent container. DECISION36.

agent-service.name: Agent Service
agent-service.note: Unmerged modular-shell candidate; independent container. DECISION36.

ai-connection.name: AI connections
ai-connection.note: One app per AI provider (Claude, ChatGPT, ...), contract wizard.ai-connection/1. Several installed at once is normal; Resources shows them all. Replaces AI Accounts (decision #61).

claude-subscription.name: Claude connection
claude-subscription.note: The Claude connection app ships on every box next to ChatGPT: it holds the agent's own Claude Code sign-in (fresh: the shared Claude volume; alongside: the host Hermes' Claude login folder), renews it when it expires and offers Connect/Test. Without it an expired Claude sign-in only shows up as a failed chat.

troubleshooter.name: Wizard Troubleshooter
troubleshooter.note: Independent recovery component; must not depend on Agent Service or the agent it repairs. DRAFT distribution: host provisioning, owner-only routing and public access are release gates; app installation/health is not host-recovery acceptance.

connection-router.name: Connection Router
connection-router.note: Connect installed apps to tested models and services with explicit owner-approved replacements.

agent-history.name: Agent History
agent-history.note: Reserved for wizard-agent-history; Wizard app packaging is pending, so no default is published yet.

voice.name: Voice
voice.note: Dictation and durable voice jobs; needs speech-to-text-engine from the existing Transcription default (transcriber).

web-search.name: Web search
web-search.note: Search works on install: a bundled SearXNG sidecar gives free private web and image results with no account or key. Optional AI overviews come from the Tinfoil app when the owner turns them on.

cloudflare-connection.name: Cloudflare
cloudflare-connection.summary: Publish websites, back up files and manage domains. Sign in after installing.

connected-accounts.name: Connected accounts
connected-accounts.summary: Connect your Google account. Available when a reviewed release is published.
connected-accounts.note: Account connector broker; Google sign-in stays off on new boxes until a verified Google OAuth app exists.
